coder_notes: Registered EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Radiopharmaceutical named per W1 without isotope (dota-eb-rgd2). formulation_flag new_route reflects the locoregional (intracavitary via Ommaya) arm; the IV arm is standard route. device_dependent kept false: the Ommaya reservoir is an implanted access port, not a device that activates the drug or opens the BBB; R4 could be read to make it true for the locoregional arm. tumour_pk_planned coded no: PK is blood/urine; tumour absorbed dose is from SPECT/CT dosimetry imaging, not tissue/CSF sampling. NOTA-PRGD2 PET is required for every patient at entry, so listed as diagnostic_agent. Integrin αvβ3 PET-uptake selection is explicitly described as a biomarker (target engagement) in the record, so recorded as 'other'; eligibility row marked uncertain for adjudication. cns5 coded from the 'Glioblastoma IDH Wildtype' condition; inclusion itself says only 'WHO classification', so 'unclear' is the alternative.
